name: Bass in the Gravel
prompt: Scatter islands of pale gravel on huge black vibrating plates arranged in a long curve. Bass waves sort the grains into intricate standing-wave patterns among the dancers' feet. One silent plate stays smooth beside a violet amplifier.

name: The Dancefloor Has Pockets
prompt: Sew an enormous orange velvet dance mat with deep pocket-shaped hollows. Each hollow shelters a smaller blue-lit dance circle. People at the rim pass glowing ribbons down into the pockets to conduct a rhythm across the floor.

name: A Ball of Mirror Fragments
prompt: Split a huge mirrored disco sphere into widely separated curved wedges on short supports. Dancers occupy the open centre and the passages between fragments. A single green beam jumps across the curved silver interiors to a tiny DJ desk.

name: The Ribbon Pulse
prompt: Suspend one continuous red light strip in angular folds just above the ground. Dancers step across the strip as a pulse travels through it, creating a visible ripple of raised feet. A lone seated drummer controls the speed.

name: The Quiet Frequency
prompt: Make a series of concentric shallow pools with glowing violet rims. Dancers wearing bone-white headphones stand on individual dry stepping discs. Their steps generate intersecting ripples that are the only shared score across the dark water.
